supported_claims.text: 明 combines meanings; the window variant 朙 also includes a phonetic contribution.
Sound comparison for 囧: jiǒng / míng (Mandarin (pinyin)).
Baxter–Sagart comparison: 囧 *k-mraŋʔ and 明 *mraŋ.

disagreements.text: The earliest eye-and-moon form is not securely identified as this character. Exactly how all the variant spellings relate remains uncertain.
